NONE: › a toy consisting of a circular object that can be made to go up and down a long piece of string to which it is tied
游遊拉線盤，溜溜球（一種玩具）
› used to refer to something that moves up and down quickly, or something that changes repeatedly between one level and another
搖擺不定的，不斷反覆變化的
› also yo-yo side, yo-yo team, elevator club a football club that repeatedly moves between higher and lower divisions (= groups of teams who play each other)
悠悠俱樂部（不停升級又降級的足球俱樂部）

example: West Brom were something of a yo-yo side, winning promotion one season only to be relegated the next.
西布朗隊有些像個悠悠俱樂部，在一個賽季剛剛升級了，結果下一個賽季又被降級。
